items.body:
Following up last year's ace 'Off The Record', Roméo Poirier works with his father, Philippe Lamiral Poirer, on a series of tracks based on his written texts, and evocative spoken word expressions that Roméo animates with suitably effervescent exotica-inspired productions.

A versatile musician, painter and filmmaker who was best known for his work in French "ambient rock" band Kat Onoma, Philippe Poirier died last year, leaving behind a deep catalog. 'Images parlées' is a touching reflection on his impact on Roméo's own artistic path that's different from anything in the younger Poirier's catalog to date. It's led by Philippe's breathy, poetic recitations that even in isolation would already be worth checking into. Roméo rises to the challenge, calling back to the glory days of French exotica - think Jean-Claude Vannier's work on Serge Gainsbourg's landmark 1971 album 'Histoire de Melody Nelson' - and infusing a medley of Hammond vamps, reverberating strings and double bass with his signature smeared glitches and subtle loops. 

What's remarkable about 'Images parlées' is how restrained it is. Recorded between 2022 and 2024, it plays like a celebration of the father and son duo's artistic connection, not a solemn, somber remembrance but trans-generational meeting place, between '70s French avant-lounge and contemporary collage. On 'En soixante et en dix-huit', Philippe's voice swerves from an almost-whisper to almost-singing as Roméo meets his energy with moody Gallic organs and Moog wails that he cuts with even more archaic elements: 78rpm recordings of early French music hall gear that Roméo appears to scratch as it plays. 

Crucial listening FFO Jan Jelinek, Andrew Pekler, or the Gallic end of the Finders Keepers reissue programme.
items._cn_summary: 这是一张父子合作的实验性专辑，已故法国诗人兼音乐家菲利普的诗歌朗诵与儿子罗密欧的电子拼贴制作相结合。音乐跨越七十年代法国前卫 lounge 与当代电子拼贴美学，融汇 Hammond 风琴、Moog 合成器、混响弦乐与低保真 glitch 循环，还穿插了 78 转老唱片采样与早期法国音乐厅素材。整体风格克制内敛，介于实验电子、环境声响与法式异域风之间，体现出两代艺术家之间的精神对话。与 Jan Jelinek、Andrew Pekler 及 Finders Keepers 再版系列的美学取向一脉相承，适合偏好实验声响、拼贴手法与诗歌文本结合的听众。

items.body:
Toronto-based brothers Kevin and Patrick Cahill return to Death Is Not The End with another set of introspective folk-inspired instrumentals.

They might play nylon strung guitar and make what's in all respects "folk" music, but East of the Valley Blues don't draw from the expected sources, balancing out their interest in Americana with an understanding of music from across the world that genuinely widens their perspective. So their percussive opener 'Sitting in the Poem' can swerve utterly fluidly from serpentine Tuareg-inspired riffage to Fahey-esque fingerstyle and you barely notice it. And 'The Spider Underneath' can sound utterly outside the timeline, playing like an extended post-rock jam recorded in a basement in North Africa.

Taking one side of the stereo spectrum each, the brothers play off each other perfectly, leaving us to fill in the gaps. And they peak on the brilliant 'Like Fitzcarraldo', seemingly blending South American styles and plodding rock - no need to tug a steamboat over a mountain though, right? Or play Enrico Caruso in the Amazon.
items._cn_summary: 这是一张由多伦多兄弟Kevin和Patrick Cahill创作的器乐专辑，以尼龙弦吉他为核心，却打破了传统民谣的边界。专辑将美式原声吉他技法与多元世界音乐深度融合：开场曲将图阿雷格风格的盘旋律动与Fahey式的指弹无缝衔接；'The Spider Underneath'模拟北非地下的后摇滚即兴质感；'Like Fitzcarraldo'则将南美音乐语汇与缓慢推进的摇滚节奏并置。两位演奏者分别占据立体声场的一侧，留出大量空间供听者填补，呈现出冥想式的内省氛围。厂牌Death Is Not The End为独立地下厂牌，发行定位小众。整体而言，这是一张以民谣为骨架、以世界音乐为血肉、兼具实验精神的跨界作品。

items.body:
Deep club modernist Sa Pa mints his own new label, Dub Techno For Life, with four top drawer cuts of textured, strident pressure tipped FFO classic Chain Reaction x Short Span.

Since 2015 Sa Pa has carved a heads-down path between techno, proper, and its conceptual adjuncts in ambient and sound designer atmospheres, most recently on Short Span and Astral Industries. Now taking matters into his own hands, the ‘Girls on Tour EP’ squares up his most robust club material alongside more experimental urges for a definitive self-portrait displaying a fine spectrum of strengths. 

The four tunes clearly speak to his diversity within a theme, checking for a firm touchstone in Andreas Tilliander aka Mokira with the 10 mins of rolling, claggy heft to ‘Mokira Ultra Dub’, unshelving his 2016 rework for deep ’26 ‘floors, alongside the puckered elegance of ‘Waiting For You’, harking to roots in Teutonic house minimalism, whereas the B-side attends to grubbier urges in the bittersweet, sludgy budge of ‘Modular System’, and lusher, abstract feels on the Actress or Rezzett-esque whorl of ‘World Saving Banger’.
items._cn_summary: 这是一张以深沉俱乐部技术（dub techno）为核心的四曲EP，融合了氛围音乐与声音设计的实验元素，呈现从滚动厚重的dub质感、极简主义到抽象朦胧的多元面貌。艺术家Sa Pa于2015年起活跃于地下电子场景，曾发行于Short Span与Astral Industries等小众氛围厂牌，此番自创厂牌Dub Techno For Life，展现出更成熟的个人美学。音乐受经典Chain Reaction厂牌影响，兼具Mokira的工业质感与Actress/Rezzett式的抽象声响处理。整体定位为地下俱乐部与现代声音艺术的交汇地带，对电子与实验音乐爱好者具有较高参考价值。

items.body:
Donato Dozzy & Neel’s beloved ambient techno project return with a 2nd raft of floating, swaying structures some 13 years since the their maiden push-off, reliably reprising the formula of their expansive epic.

Out of earshot for a minute, Voices From the Lake regroup around familiar aquatic themes on the satisfyingly immersive ‘II’. Signature Italian sound sensitivity and attention to spatialized detail meets subtle rhythmic urges for an hour of slowed, aquaplaning groove and crystal clear tones that dive off from deep ends of ‘80s new age ambient, and its ‘90s techno descendants, into an elemental sound world idealised for horizontal listening - or perhaps a slinky eyes-shut bop, if the mood takes.

It’s all too easy to slip into anodyne flotation tank waft within this realm, but the finely attuned sensitivities of Dozzy & Neel buoy this one, like their previous, to a point of usefulness as meditation aid and ambient music that harmonises with the background of whatever space it’s projected into. Blessed with restraint yet richly resonating across the frequency spectrum, the 10 tracks flows naturally from the stealthily unfolding envelopes of ‘Eos’ thru properly charming offbeat pulses in ‘Ian’ that surely evoke a sort of underwater xmas vibe in the same way we hold AFX’s SAW 85-92 as a seasonal perennial.

““The project was never meant to become what it did,” the duo reflect. “At one point, we even paused it. Only to later embrace it in all its forms. II is both a continuation and a reinvention.” True to that spirit, Voices From The Lake have explored extremes in recent years, from high-tempo live sets to seated listening concerts, while remaining anchored in the meditative pulse of ambient techno. II extends this lineage, carrying forward the immersive sound design and boundary-pushing vision that has defined their work from the beginning.”
items._cn_summary: 意大利电子双人组Donato Dozzy与Neel以Voices From The Lake之名发布第二张专辑，距离首作已过去十三年。作品延续了两人标志性的环境科技路线，以水下意象为核心，将八十年代新世纪氛围音乐与九十年代科技舞曲的基因融为一体。十首曲目构建出沉浸式声场，注重空间细节与微妙律动的平衡，音色清澈通透，节奏放缓如浮游水面。专辑呈现一种适合横卧聆听或闭目冥想的质感，既可作为冥想辅助，也能在任何空间中与背景自然融合。整体在延续既有美学的基础上进行了适度革新，展现了意大利电子音乐人对声音质感的精细把控。

items.body:
Much needed reissue of Stephen Hitchell’s sleepwalking dub house trips, faithfully remastered by Pole for posterity and optimal immersion. FFO Maurizio, GAS, Shinichi Atobe.

Echospace’s Stephen Hitchell is in his element as Intrusion on two durational treks deep into the studio haze. Also found in much longer versions on original release, back in 2015, ‘A Gentle Embrace’ appears here thru13 min timeframes ideal for long blends in-the-mix, or more simply enjoyed on their own, floating and soporific terms.

The original puffs up a sublime architecture of diffused fumes and rolling, velvet-coated bass that yearns upward, outwards with a gorgeous sense of deferred gratification that he tempers to an even more light-headed feel in the B-side reduction, whisking the choral pads and chords to cirrus wisps and beatific harmony.
items._cn_summary: 这张专辑呈现的是深沉氛围的Dub House电子乐，Stephen Hitchell以Intrusion身份探索工作室朦胧音景中的长篇旅程。音乐以弥漫的烟雾质感和天鹅绒般滚动的低音构建出层次丰富的声学建筑，圣咏般的pad与和弦在A面铺陈出延宕的满足感，B面则将人声和弦乐提炼为更轻盈的卷云质感。Pole操刀的重新母带处理保证了最佳的沉浸听感。整体风格贴近Maurizio、GAS和Shinichi Atoe的深邃电子传统，是面向DJ长时段混音或个人聆听的催眠式氛围电子作品，属于小众独立电子场景中的精品重发。

items.body:
A hardy perennial, Boards of Canada’s definitive "lost" 1995 debut is back in circulation for the first time in a few years.

Originally dished up on Marcus and Eoin Sanderson’s Music70 label in edition of only 100 copies in 1995, rumour has it that a copy was sent to Clair Poulton at Clear Records as a demo, who passed on it before Skam up in mcr signed up the pair for the Hi Scores 12", Aquarius 7" and eventually 'Music Has The Right To Children', released in conjunction with Warp. By the time Twoism was officially reissued in 2002, people had been known to spend upwards of £500 for original copies if they were lucky enough to find them.

Alongside Hi Scores, Twoism provides the definitive BoC blueprint, melding classic electro tropes with analog synth tones redolent of soundtracks to ‘70s and ‘80s Canadian nature programmes, sewing the seeds of a sound that would bloom in their classic 1998 side ‘Music Has The Right To Children’. It still slaps.
items._cn_summary: Boards of Canada 1995年首张专辑《Twoism》再版，隶属IDM与电子音乐范畴。作品以经典电子手法为骨架，融入模拟合成器音色，整体氛围让人联想到七十至八十年代加拿大自然纪录片配乐。唱片当年仅以一百张限量发行于自家厂牌，后经Skam与Warp等独立厂牌推向更广受众，被视为该组合后续经典专辑《Music Has The Right To Children》的雏形。乐评以历史回顾为主，简要点明了作品的声响特征与定位。整体而言，这是一张在电子音乐史上具有源头意义的作品，温暖怀旧的模拟质感与电子节拍的结合具有较高辨识度。

items.body:
'When the land is laid bare' from the California based duo of Benjamin Burke and Bear Glass, Shape of the Moon.

"Following streams of consciousness that contemplate the stardust that forms us to the very first human sound that reverberated through a cave, Shape of the Moon intertwines language and music into ambient dream-weaving narratives.

When the land is laid bare forms a collection of recordings composed of Burke reciting his introspective poems and Glass improvising gripping modular synth and string patterns. Burke brings a wealth of experience working between an impressively vast range of written and visual mediums to Glass’s live electronics and acoustic instrumentation mirroring the spoken word. The pieces on the album consist of excerpts from live outdoor performances under the night sky in the Mojave desert as well as sessions in Glass’s off-grid solar powered studio. Burke drapes vivid vocal narration over deeply immersive textures and melodies conjured up by Glass on Buchla, bass and sitar, painting peaks and valleys that live score the storytelling. The duo tread their own path fusing poetry with undulating electroacoustic instrumentals, arriving at meditative and ASMR territories that draw inspiration from ambient and electronica. Often joined on stage by guest musicians playing anything from Rhodes, percussion, jaw harp and saxophone, the recordings edge towards blues and spiritual jazz.

Benjamin Burke is a poet, writer, performer, and visual artist who spends his time lending a hand to unusual artistic expeditions around the world. Most recently, he helped to launch Dhun and Dhun School, a humanist eco-township and progressive education center on a 500 acre biopreserve in Rajasthan, India. He has written and performed countless unusual shows, experimenting widely and, through that, witnessing firsthand what makes ideas resonate for his audiences. This work evolved over time into an approach he refers to as Applied Poetics which he employs to help communities set intentions, scientists present their findings, and humanitarian organizations find their footing.

Bear Glass is a sound artist, multi-instrumentalist, music teacher, live sound engineer, and founding member of Mobius Acoustics who build innovative sound systems and host events on the West Coast (utilizing a quadraphonic setup for live performances and immersive drone bath sessions). Glass is involved in various collaborative projects with a couple of releases under different pseudonyms as well as a solo tape featuring a track with prolific producer Carlos Niño. For most of the year, Glass lives sustainably off-grid with his family on a plot of land outside Joshua Tree, a mini utopia infamous for his well curated private campouts and artist residencies. Wide skies, magnificent climates, and being surrounded by the love of family and friends inform Bear’s musical output and artistic practice."

items.body:
Cloud-seeding dub techno sorcery x Rhythm & Sound worship by Stephen Hitchell’s cult cv313 and Radius projects, recorded in the heart of Detroit and preserved for posterity by Pole’s faithful remasters at Scape Berlin.

Echospace co-pilot Stephen Hitchell mans the cockpit solo on six sterling examples of Motor City dub techno purism within the 1st volume of ‘Altering Illusions’. His hallucinatory, synaesthetic tekkerz are in palpable effect from the damp bass thru to its noctilucent synth haze, bathing bodies in blissed-out arrangements that unfold up to 20 minutes in length, as with the echoes of BC’s ‘radiance’ registered in expansive parting piece ‘standing still’, and dredged up from drizzly depths on the cv313 rewire of Radius’ ‘Interpolation Tapes’.

Clubs are in the rearview for an 80 min trip deep under the hood of Echospace’s classic sound, fathoming deepest levels of sunken subs and elemental attrition on ‘i s i s’, and hingeing on Rhythm & Sound’s skankers' templates in ‘hypnosphere’ and mesmerising metallic resonance of ‘irradiate’, while ‘above clouds’ rises above the weather system into clearer, blue-skied dub techno lushness; think post-storm Lake Erie panoramas diffused by Wolfgang Voigt’s GAS.
items._cn_summary: Stephen Hitchell以cv313名义独立操刀的底特律dub techno作品集，由Pole旗下Scape Berlin厂牌重新母带处理。六首曲目深入dub techno极简主义精髓，时长延伸至二十分钟。音乐呈现潮湿低频基底与夜光般的合成器雾气，大量致敬Rhythm & Sound的dub techno美学。作品在深沉次低频的探索与环境氛围之间游走，部分段落如'above clouds'呈现出类似Wolfgang Voigt的GAS项目般的开阔音景。整体定位为面向地下电子乐迷的长篇沉浸式聆听体验，属底特律techno传统与dub美学的深度融合，在ambient与实验电子的边界地带展开声音实验。

items.body:
The unexpected follow-up to 2019's engimatic 'Piri Piri Samplers' set, 'Making Friends' is a fusion of various cracked folk styles, Americana, fuzzy drone and saturated blues that's perfectly eccentric - and perfectly at home on Belgium's always reliable STROOM imprint.

When STROOM hit up guitarists Andreu G. Serra and Kiran Leonard to reissue 'Piri Piri Samplers', the label made sure to mention that if they were to record together again, they'd be interested in hearing it. Of Sobre Blau was formed in 2017 when Serra and Leonard were both living in Lisbon; since then, Leonard had moved to London and Serra to southern Catalonia so jamming together seemed impossible. It almost didn't happen but, soon, Serra was on his way to London (he's now moved there permanently) and the project was in full swing. 'Making Friends' was assembled from six months of weekly sessions, the two playing various instruments (pianos, guitars, drums, samplers) and singing in Catalan and English, improvising and writing, chopping away at their growing archive of recordings.

And the long process - 'Piri Piri Samplers' was assembled from just three half-hour improvisations - leads to a deeper, more labyrinthine record than its predecessor. The lightheartedness of early tracks like the Gastr del Sol-ish 'Action Park Sargent', that counters its jangling guitars with percussion from a literal jackhammer, and the brief Caroline-esque 'Action Park #2' melt into the exceptionally odd centerpiece 'Top of Duboce - Tyne Bridge Crossing', an eight-and-a-half minute muddle of distorted drone, field recordings and noise that's led by a spoken word performance from Enablers frontman Pete Simonelli. That's not even the only lengthy central moment, either - Serra and Leonard put the same amount of juice into 'Sirenes', pulling inspiration from Bill Orcutt's recent solo run and hacking away furiously over thick, billowing tones.
items._cn_summary: 这是吉他手安德烈·G·塞拉与基兰·莱昂纳德合作的实验民谣作品，融合了碎裂民谣、美式根源音乐、模糊嗡鸣与饱和布鲁斯等多种元素。专辑由六个月每周一次的即兴会话拼贴而成，二人交替使用钢琴、吉他、鼓与采样器，以加泰罗尼亚语和英语演唱。作品以即兴创作为核心方法论，音景从明快吉他段落到长达八分半的失真嗡鸣与田野录音噪音不等，中央段落包含Enablers主唱皮特·西蒙内利的念白表演。整体气质怪诞而独立，呈现出自由即兴、嗡鸣噪音与欧洲地域民谣之间的深度跨界融合，由比利时地下厂牌STROOM发行。

items.body:
Belgian avant-pop outfit Sergeant return to STROOM with a second album and a new member. RIYL Milan W, Total Blue or Animal Collective.

Since 2023's self-titled debut album, movie bro Benjamin Cools and actor Ferre Marnef have invited a new artist into the fold. The project was initially conceived as a live band, so the additional personnel just allows Sergeant to spread their creative wings; 'Symbols' is a more complicated record than its predecessor, packed out with byzantine arrangement and layered compositions, but it's also tighter. There's a feeling that their influences - '80s DIY pop, krautrock and post-punk - have been more fluidly lashed together this time around and Marnef's voice sounds more assured bedded in his collaborators' woozy, sometimes spiky productions. 

If their last record was "DJ Shadow in reverse", made from collaged elements and half-songs, 'Symbols' is a suite of proper compositions that dissolve as they play out, with tempos fluctuating and components mutating and vaporizing as Marnef sings. It's pop music that's engineered with Martin Hannett's ear for wacked-out production - fans of Ariel Pink (before he went full fash) or Panda Bear's 'Person Pitch' should investigate without delay.
items._cn_summary: 比利时前卫流行组合Sergeant发行第二张专辑《Symbols》，新增一位成员后编曲更为复杂精密，融合了八十年代DIY流行、克劳斯摇滚与后朋克的元素。制作上以Martin Hannett式的实验手法著称，音速波动、组件变幻消解，配器层次丰富。Marnef的声线在迷幻、时而尖锐的制作中显得更加从容自信。整体呈现出由拼贴碎片向完整作曲的转变，结构在展开过程中逐渐溶解。发行于荷兰独立厂牌STROOM，与Animal Collective、Panda Bear的实验流行路线相近。

items.body:
Beautiful, mystic trodders by Lee “Scratch” Perry for Cedric Myton, Congo Ashanti & Watty Burnett’s harmonious reggae vocal trio The Congos, including the wee radge packet’s Black Ark mixes.

All deriving from sessions for The Congo’s legendary debut ‘Heart of The Congos’ (1977), as issued on Perry’s Black Ark Studio-related label, Black Art, ‘Ark Of The Covenant’ best portrays the producer’s genius for innovative vocal and instrumental production that captures his performers’ spirits like few others. 

The A-side is a slice of roots heaven, framing The Congos’ swaying, layered harmonies in heat-melted chords and swollen bass, sealed within the Black Ark’s soft wooden resonance, while the original 7” B-side ‘Noah Sugar Pan’ swipes the vox into ether, revealing Perry’s treacly bass underfoot and his lysergic guitar finesse under the hood. 

Perhaps the biggest attraction, however, is Lee Perry’s Original Black Ark Mix, utterly haunted with duppied vocal refractions and phantasmic details in the air that really tickle susceptible souls and soles of feet.
items._cn_summary: 这是The Congos的根式雷鬼作品，由传奇制作人Lee "Scratch" Perry在Black Ark录音室操刀。素材源自1977年首张专辑《Heart of The Congos》的同期录音，展示了Perry标志性的实验性制作手法，包括迷幻吉他、厚重贝斯线、木质空间混响以及duppied人声折射等非常规处理手法。作品融合了根式雷鬼的律动层叠和声与dub实验精神，在传统牙买加雷鬼框架内实现了颇具先锋意识的声响探索。整体定位为带有强烈制作人个人风格的世界音乐重制/混音合集，兼顾文化根源性与声音实验性。

items.body:
Are perfumes composed? Do they evolve? Polish-Canadian trumpeter and composer Jacques Kuba Séguin says they do, emphatically, with his La Trilogie des Odeurs: Three Works, Three Universes, One Story.

In presenting an olfactory world via an auditory work of art, there is a sense that Séguin is taking things well beyond just perfume to an entire world of odors. It also suggests an entanglement of the senses, and Séguin pushes this suggestion to the max with this trilogy in three separate albums. For Parfum no. 1, he convenes a jazz quartet with pianist Jean-Michel Pilc, bassist Rémi-Jean Leblanc, drummer Kevin Warren, with vocalist Elizabeth Shepherd sitting in on one tune. Leave the connection of odor to sound to the listener here. Synesthesia—where the stimulation of one sense triggers experiences in another—is a real thing. Pianist Jessica Williams said she saw colors with every note or chord she played.

Of the three Parfum albums, No. 1, 2 and 3, Parfum no. 1 is the starkest—a spare, dry sound that may evoke the smell of desert sage as it rides the Santa Ana winds through the chaparral, picking up molecules of the menthol eucalyptus that flourishes in the riverbeds, the rich aromas of damp earth from which these craggy apparitions writhe.

There is much space here, like that desert landscape that birthed the sage. Melodic simplicity and repetition make the music sound ritualistic in a beautiful way. Elizabeth Shepherd's vocals (invocations?) in French are hushed whisperings on "Je suis là."

The music is expressed with an understated patience, as it was in Miles Davis' Ascenseur pour l'échafaud (Fontana, 1957). It is an inward sound that invites reflection and contemplation.

The three albums as a whole are described as a trilogy of smells celebrating the olfactory memories of our lives. This, in itself, marks out ambitious territory via three distinct albums—Parfum no. 1 utilizing the jazz quartet; Parfum no 2 employing a 17-piece jazz band; and Parfum no. 3 bringing in a symphony orchestra, taking the ambitious aspect off the charts.

The olfactory experiences described, auditorily, on Parfum no. 1 are subtle, whiffs of mixed fragrances. Parfum no. 2, the big band set, brings in a riot of bright smells, with brassy primary colors underlain by understated pastel scents and rainbow swirls of harmonic whirlpoolings. Scents and sounds, with their ability to appeal to ephemeral memories in the subconscious yet formative aspects of our life histories, emerge through open-ear listening.

The final chapter, Parfum no. 3 enfolds the jazz quartet with L'Orchestre Symphonique de Trois-Rivières, led by Alain Trudel. Séguin speaks of: "Base notes, or earth notes...the essence of the perfume, the part that clings to the skin and remains imprinted in objects as well as in the soul." While the first chapter of this trilogy speaks to a simplicity of expression and the elementary, youthful experience of the fragrance, Parfum no. 3 takes that early introduction into the complexities of understanding born of time and wisdom into a richer and more complex landscape. It is an illuminating listening experience, seven compositions that intertwine and respond to each other with the angelic symphonic wings of the orchestra.

CD 1: La danse du hasard; Promesse de souvenirs; Rencontre au berceau; Je suis là; Éphémère; Candeur. CD 2: La danse du hasard et des dangers; 26 printemps; Paysage pour Muniak; 40 is the new 30; Gratitude. CD 3: How we start again; Il n'y a pas de hasard; Fugue avec Anaïs (à Métis); Entre l'exil et l'insomnie - partie I L'exil; In coelum; Entre l'exil et l'insomnie - partie II L'insomnie; le cortège des fragrances - Les aléas de Mme P.

Additional Instrumentation

Elizabeth Shepherd: vocals. CD 2: L'orchestre de Nationale de Jazz de Montreal. CD 3: Orchestre des Trois Rivieres.

items.body:
Rightfully described as a thinking (wo)man's jazz musician, trumpeter-composer-bandleader Steven Bernstein makes deeply cerebral music no matter whether with his own ensembles such as Sexmob and Millennial Territory Orchestra or in heady collaborations with other artists such Jacob Fred Jazz Odyssey (see Race Riot Suite (Royal Potato Family, 2011)).

In fact, the products of his imagination resound with such visceral force that those creations render an impact comparable to his membership in Levon Helm's Midnight Ramble Band (or MTO's tribute to Sly Stone). ResoNation Trio and Ultra Resonance, are similarly charged, the former a forward-thinking yet traditionalist-leaning project for which Bernstein recruited the estimable rhythm section of bassist Scott Colley and drummer Nasheet Waits, the latter is a reimagining of that threesome's music overseen by pedigreed engineer and producer Scotty Hard (a long-time collaborator of visionaries unto themselves, Medeski Martin & Wood).

The former is as skeletal as the latter is dense. Yet the two recordings, distinctly different in concept and execution, are nevertheless inextricably linked. Each, in its own way, is a thought-provoking piece, with the respective virtues redolent when played separately or together in sequence, either in the configuration of the single CD or the double vinyl package.

The abstract likes of Bernstein-Colley-Waits' "Turf" benefit as much from the space in the arrangement as the linear progression the three pursue in "Pettiford." Meanwhile, corresponding titles of the companion piece, such as "Rubidium," function similarly, gateways into more or less otherworldly realms (though perhaps not as mesmerizing as the source of that concept, dub reggae recordings by Burning Spear on Garvey's Ghost (Island Records, 1976)).

It is not necessary to listen to Ultra Resonance on headphones to appreciate its aura. Still, that method can reveal more of the multiple layers in the recordings. And, in its own way, that method also proves to be comparatively applicable to the acoustic music: the patient and probing human three-way human interactions that comprise "Woodstock," for instance, radiate both the physical and mental effort involved in the musicianship.

Hard's deeply insistent reformulation of the music through the use of keyboards, various other instruments and percussion, in combination with Jeremy Gustin's varied rhythm devices, emits a presence as haunting as that in the spacious interplay of the ResoNation Trio. Selections from the latter like the one non-original, the blues of "Sitting On Top of the World," resound with comparable levels of mental acumen infused with technical expertise.

A comparatively spooky atmosphere thus pervades most of this seventy-six minutes, even as it is presented in cuts of mostly 3 to 5 minute duration. With its infectious lively cheer, the penultimate track by the trumpeter, bassist and drummer, titled "South," may be the exception to the rule. And the product of Scotty Hard's efforts, such as "Vibranium," are like nothing so much as an individual's inner monologue, filtered through devices, as are so many of our contemporary dialogues.  On the other hand, the acoustic portion effectively constitutes a friendly but lively debate between equals.

Accordingly, the sounds from the three-man ensemble flicker in and out of the well-defined, but dark audio mix during "Argon." And, without ever going on too long to become monotonous, there are just enough similar turns of melody to render more pronounced the heavily rhythmic likes of "Titano." In the end, the overall pacing is that of a well-sequenced live set, without an overabundance of aural esoterica.

It is thus indicative of the seamless yet malleable nature of ResoNation Trio and Ultra Resonance that various elements from each can be interwoven with the other. Reprogramming the CD tracks or alternating the four sides of vinyl extends both the accessibility and the durability of Steven Bernstein and company's eccentric musical orthodoxy.

Turf; Pettiford; Two Shakes; Woodstock; August 3; West; Mammoth; Question; South; Sitting on Top of the World; Argon; Erbium; Chromium; Vibranium; Rubidium; Titano; Radon; Niobium.

Additional Instrumentation

Steven Bernstein: G-trumpet, flugelhorn, EVI; Scotty Hard: Roland 606, Bias BS- 2, Akai MPG 2500, Serato Sampler, Yamaha CS-50, Moog Voyager; lap steel, feedback, percussion. Scott Colley: acoustic bass; Jeremy Gustin: bass drum, floor tom, pandeiro, percussion.

items.body: Broken rhythmic structures, exquisite sub-bass stutters, and destabilized funk mechanics colliding into something gloriously unhinged. It’s machine music with bloodstream heat—tactile, sensual, and absolutely devastating at volume. A four-track detonation of chrome-plated futurism whø’s latest transmission for Who Is Paula arrives like a preserved artifact from a parallel electro continuum where the 808 never stopped evolving and the 303 became an instrument of ecstatic machine hypnosis. Riding The Bassline is a four-track detonation of chrome-plated futurism, channeling the spirit of classic electro stylings through circuitry that feels simultaneously archival and startlingly alive. Every kick lands with pneumatic force, every bassline curls and mutates like liquid neon threading through a midnight motorway. The title track surges forward in a state of pure kinetic elevation, bubbling through synthetic cityscapes with elastic low-end pressure, celestial pads, and razor-edged drum programming that seems purpose-built for sweat-soaked dancefloor communion. We’ve only just started, and whø? simply doesn’t let up. “Voices” follows with a tougher mechanical stride before dissolving into waves of euphoric synth architecture and glowing harmonics that radiate outward like signals from some forgotten pleasure satellite. “Teebee Love” pivots toward a more eroticized strain of electro-funk, its grinding bass motif locking into a hypnotic body rhythm before erupting into a soaring string-pad climax of near-operatic intensity. Closing cut “I Can’t Get Enough Of That” pushes furthest into fractured territory: broken rhythmic structures, exquisite sub-bass stutters, and destabilized funk mechanics colliding into something gloriously unhinged. It’s machine music with bloodstream heat—tactile, sensual, and absolutely devastating at volume. Electron waves rise high.Paula‘s eyes half open, heart pounding, as she seeks the line, carving through the curving crown.And as the sine collapses she exits as one. Riding The Bassline is available on Who Is Paula. [Bandcamp] Riding The Bassline by whø? Who Is Paula · WIP011 – whø? – Riding The Bassline – Snippets
items._cn_summary: 这是一张由独立厂牌Who Is Paula发行的四曲EP，扎根于经典电声传统，融合808鼓机、303合成器与未来主义音色设计。音乐在electro框架内引入破碎节奏结构、低频失真与不稳定funk律动，呈现出机械质感与有机温度并存的声响美学。曲目从动能推进的标题曲到更具机械硬度的'Voices'，再到带有情色律动的'Teebee Love'，最终以解构力度最强的'Can't Get Enough Of That'收尾，逐步深化实验性。整体制作精良，音色层次丰富，弦乐pad与人声元素带来近乎歌剧式的情绪高潮。对电子音乐尤其是electro方向的听众具有较强吸引力，在传统与实验之间取得平衡。

items.body: Bei Human Space Machine handelt es sich nicht um den nervigen Ellenbogen-Proleten auf dem Dancefloor, sondern um einen niederländischen Techno-Act. Er würde wohl kaum auf Midgar erscheinen, wenn sich seine Musik nicht an der Grenze zur Klangforschung bewegen würde. Soll heißen: Auch die EP Perception Field ist selten nur vorwärts gedacht, sondern beweist ein Gespür für die feinen Zwischentöne, die Maschinenmusik ermöglicht. Psychedelik, Hall, das böse Wort Tribalismus? Der dahingehend betitelte Track »Totem« sediert trotz seines vergleichsweise hohen Tempos mit organischen Geräuschen aus anorganischer Materie, hallt wie jener See, aus dem Donato Dozzy und Neel eine Klangsignatur für die Ewigkeit schufen. Auch der Opener »The Field« weist eine gewisse Geschwindigkeit auf, entwickelt aber die eigenwillige Gangart einer fiebrigen Reagenzglasgeburt im Ambient-Deckmantel. Auf »U77« dengeln über moderater Geschwindigkeit metallene Glockenschläge relativ klar, obwohl man sich auf der Turmwendeltreppe immer weiter bergab in die Dunkelheit begibt, ein Track gewordenes Castlevania mit komplementären Basseinsätzen. »Gallop« ballert polyrhythmisch auf Höchstgeschwindigkeit und lullt dabei mit Glockenspielereien ein. Tech-House-Anwandlungen in Bass-Music-Ästhetik wie bei Wisdom Teeth, fulminant durchexerziert. Konzeptionell der gelungenste Track einer EP, die vieles ist, aber sicherlich keine Gebrauchsmusik.
items._cn_summary: Human Space Machine 是来自荷兰的实验电子/Techno 制作人，此张 EP 游走于声音研究与氛围营造之间。评论指出作品并非功能性舞曲，而是带有实验精神的艺术化创作，融合了迷幻音景、混响空间与部落节奏元素，类似于 Donato Dozzy 与 Neel 的深邃 Techno 脉络。开场曲在速度与氛围之间找到平衡，呈现发烧试管般的怪异律动；中段作品以金属钟声下行盘旋，构建出类似游戏配乐式的暗黑叙事；终曲则以高密度复合节奏配合铃声碎拍，将 Tech-House 的律动逻辑置入 Bass Music 的美学框架中。整体属于地下实验电子范畴，侧重声响质地的雕琢与节奏结构的非传统处理，与实验电子、深 Techno 与氛围音乐爱好者高度契合。

items.body: Athens duo Incirrina have released the album “Trace” on the German label Cold Transmission Music. The Incirrina “Trace” album runs to 11 tracks and follows the duo’s two previous albums, “8.15” (2019) and “Lip Led Scream” (2022). The band describe “Trace” as built around freedom, identity and resistance. The 11 tracks were written between 2023 and 2025 and recorded through a 24-channel console, using analogue electronic instruments and the duo’s vocals. The album follows “Lip Led Scream” (2022), the duo’s first record for Cold Transmission Music. “Trace” is issued on vinyl (black and crystal-clear), CD, a limited cassette and digital. “Mutate” and “Always Here” were released as advance singles, and “Mutate” has an accompanying video on YouTube. The album is available through Cold Transmission Music (coldtransmission.com) and the band’s Bandcamp. Trace by Incirrina About Incirrina Incirrina is a dark electronic and minimal synth duo based in Athens, Greece, formed in late 2017 by George Katsanos (synthesizers, drum machine, waterphone, vocals) and Irini Tiniakou (synthesizers, vocals). The duo describe their work as “dark, poetic, electronic,” pairing analogue synth lines and drum-machine rhythms with Tiniakou’s vocals. Tiniakou first appeared as a guest vocalist on a release by the Greek act Metal Disco before Incirrina became a project in its own right. The duo debuted with the album “8.15” (2019, Geheimnis Records), a record drawing on the work of the 18th-century poet William Blake. They followed it with the digital maxi-single “Utter” (2020) and a 2021 split maxi-single with The Man & His Failures, “Devastations / R.Daneel,” on Smash Records. Their second album, “Lip Led Scream” (2022), was their first release for Germany’s Cold Transmission Music, which has handled their releases since. In 2024 they released the double single “Immersion” (“Presence” and “Alien Room”), also on Cold Transmission Music. In an April 2023 Side-Line reviewer Inferno Sound Diaries described “Lip Led Scream” as “a pure Cold-Wave production which is sometimes reinforced with harder, EBM, elements” and as “a well-crafted and fully enjoyable work without any single cut to throw away,” rating it 8/10. The duo have performed in Greece, Germany, Belgium, Hungary and Croatia, with festival appearances at Plíísken Festival, Morphic Festival, Cold Transmission Festival. Death Disco Festival – The Warm Up, Athens Music Week, Metavasis Festival and the Athens Digital Arts Festival. “Trace,” their third album, is their latest release for Cold Transmission Music.
items._cn_summary: Incirrina是来自希腊雅典的二人电子组合，由George Katsanos和Irini Tiniakou于2017年底组建，作品风格定位为暗潮、极简合成器与冷波，融合EBM节奏元素，辅以模拟合成器、鼓机和水琴等非常规乐器编制。女主唱Tiniakou的人声与模拟合成器线条交织，营造出黑暗、诗意的电子声响质感。乐队此前作品曾引用18世纪英国诗人威廉·布莱克的文本，显示一定的文学性追求。Trace为该组合第三张专辑，收录11首曲目，通过24通道调音台录制，已由德国独立厂牌Cold Transmission Music发行黑胶、CD、限量磁带及数字版本。乐队曾在希腊、德国、比利时、匈牙利、克罗地亚等地演出，活跃于欧洲地下暗潮场景。整体定位属于欧洲独立暗潮厂牌体系内具有文学底色的冷波电子项目。

items.body: Kurs Murder (P. 1) Swiss Dark Nights One-man Italian act Kurs has had both its musical aesthetic and a unique approach to LP release locked in from its 2021 debut, and isn’t deviating from that approach the third time out. As with preceding Kurs records, Murder (P. 1) isn’t just a concept record in and of itself but also ships with a graphic novel fleshing that concept out. Lacking said book we can only presume that this is intended as the first volume of an ongoing series of records/books, but you don’t need that larger context in order to appreciate Valerio Rivieccio’s yen for moody and stormy electro-industrial. Kurs remains a project which rewards focused headphone listening rather than club fodder hunting, and the loping rhythmic slither and numbly distorted hums on lead single “Weapon” are a great demonstration of why we’ve been waiting so keenly for Kurs’ next move. The ebb and flow of the track’s build and release is considered and never rushed, building towards churning drums and acidic vocals, but along the way there’s much in the way of satisfying and finely textured programming that’s catnip to the seasoned rivethead. Those moves don’t just take the form of traditionally noisy elements, either; opener “Precinct” gradually expands in scope, pulling back from the minimal, chilly EBM pulse of its first moments into a more cinematic mode framed by horns. As always, Kurs is a project whose roots are easy to spot if one cares to look for them, but Murder (P. 1) never comes up short even in that sort of perspective. The influence Front Line Assembly has on Kurs, which has always been detectable in the corners of the preceding records, becomes more apparent on a number of pieces here, as on the Leeb-esque chorus of “Murder” and on the galloping programming of “Basement” which treads the line between martial bombast and pure clattering chaos. Lifts like that don’t necessarily hit the most overt aesthetic or musical cues other bands have taken from FLA, though, and as with preceding LPs Muter and Dreamer so much work has gone into building up Kurs’ own world of sound and atmosphere that these moments (or the occasional parallel with mid-period Haujobb) feel like tips of the hat and never overt coattail riding. The imagery conjured by Murder (P. 1)‘s titles and lyrics are plenty evocative even sans accompanying text, and it’s easy to build a Deus Ex or Dark City inspired landscape in your mind’s eye as you listen. If that all sounds like nostalgia for cyber-dystopias of the past rather than the one we’re living in, fair enough, but once again Kurs have put so much work into their craft that the histories they’re drawing upon soon fade from the listener’s mind as they enjoy Kurs qua Kurs. Buy it. Murder (P. 1) by Kurs The post Kurs, “Murder (P. 1)” appeared first on I Die: You Die.

items._cn_summary: 这是一张弦乐演奏者Turner Williams Jr.的作品，出身于美国阿拉巴马超现实主义音乐场景，现居法国马赛。专辑被描述为'奇妙而怪异的集合'，展现出强烈的实验气质与跨界色彩。评论来源Songlines以世界音乐见长，暗示作品可能融合了美国南方根源音乐元素与欧洲即兴传统。弦乐作为主要载体，结合超现实主义美学和跨文化背景，指向自由即兴、当代古典与世界音乐交汇的领域。阿拉巴马超现实主义场景本身极为小众，体现出独立另类的创作立场。整体定位偏向地下实验与跨文化即兴音乐，与先锋爵士、当代古典、世界融合等方向均有交集，但因评论原文信息极为有限，无法对其具体声响设计与作品深度做更详尽判断。

items._cn_summary: Tuuletar是来自芬兰的四人声乐组合，自定位为'人声民谣说唱'（vocal folk hop）。他们的音乐将芬乌语系的紧密和声传统与beatbox节奏手法相融合，以纯人声手段构建音乐层叠结构，涵盖民谣旋律线条与嘻哈式节奏律动。作为世界音乐领域的跨界项目，其核心特色在于以声乐技巧替代器乐编制，属于人声实验与世界音乐融合的范畴。芬兰的芬乌语系民歌传统在全球化语境中具有独特文化视角，beatbox的加入也为传统人声赋予了现代节奏语汇。不过原文仅为简短预告，信息量极为有限，未涉及专辑具体的编曲细节、曲目结构、制作水准或艺术价值的深入讨论，对音乐全貌的判断存在较大不确定性。

items.body: Review by The Progolyte — Wow, what a hidden gem! Capitolo 6 was one of the countless Italian bands from this period who flirted with progressive rock, but for me, I'd say they're one of the finest examples of a Rock Progressivo Italiano band that just never got its footing while active and never got the praise it deserves years later. The one album they did make, Frutti Per Kagua, is an amazing compilation of engaging jams, technical progressive rock, and twinges of jazz rock, all mixed in with a heavy edge that echoes what the band's English counterparts were doing at the same time. I noticed a very clear similarity to Jumbo, not only musically but vocally as well. Their singer, Riccardo Bartolotti (who also does some guitar and flute here and there), has that same raspy and intense quality that catches your ear whenever you listen to Alvaro Fella sing on a Jumbo album. On the topic of the personnel, Jimmy Santerini plays keyboards and does some singing parts, Lorenzo Donati does the drumming and is also listed as helping with the vocals, Maurizio Romani plays the bass, and Loriano Berti performs as the band's saxophonist and flutist. The record opens with the phenomenal twenty-minute-long title track, which is my favorite piece on the whole record and contains some extremely interesting and well-put-together music. It's a fascinating mix of bluesy, guitar-heavy rock music, blissful folk compositions, emotionally driving melodies and jamming and is overall a great experience that has a great sense of direction and identity. It really goes to show how far this group could've gone if they had gotten the recognition they deserved. Side two has the other three tracks, none of which are quite as long but generally have a good frame for length. The energy on side one continues as each piece is full of captivating moments of pure power and very dynamic material that truly breathes and flows greatly. The fast-paced, almost jazz fusion-like rhythms are only contrasted by the calming seas of acoustic material, but overall the music here is very much on the electric side of things. Overall, it's all very strong and a great representation of Rock Progressivo Italiano at its core, with both charming and grittier tones of the scene. In conclusion, I would highly recommend this band for anyone wanting to expand their knowledge on the map of Italian prog. It's very reminiscent of some of the classics while also feeling fresh and fun. It may not be an absolute essential, but to me it is deserving of a very strong 4.25/5.
items._cn_summary: Capitolo 6是1972年意大利前卫摇滚乐队，他们的唯一专辑《Frutti Per Kagua》融合了技术性前卫摇滚、爵士摇滚和民谣元素。开场曲是一首约二十分钟的长篇作品，呈现蓝调摇滚、吉他驱动的硬摇滚、民谣段落与情感旋律的交织。乐队编制包括键盘、吉他、贝斯、鼓、萨克斯和长笛，主唱Riccardo Bartolotti的演唱粗粝有力，与同时期意大利乐队Jumbo主唱Alvaro Fella风格相近。唱片B面收录三首较短曲目，延续首张的能量与动态变化，明快的爵士融合节奏与原声段落形成对比。整体偏向电气化路线，是意大利前卫摇滚场景中一个被忽视的案例，展现了该流派在七十年代初的多样面貌。

items.body: The Witch Said No is a relatively obscure project from Russia that has been active for several years and has already released a number of recordings in its home country, including a debut album. Very little is known about the project itself, which only adds to its mysterious aura. Earlier this year, the band released a new EP through the Slovak label Aliens Production, featuring three new tracks alongside six remixes. The Witch Said No delivers a powerful form of Dark-Electro driven by bombastic heavy beats and overwhelming repetitive sequences, topped with an almost completely unintelligible, hateful vocal style. The title track is certainly an interesting discovery, while the two remaining new songs follow a similar direction but prove slightly less convincing. The remixes of the title track were created by KIFOTH, Deadjump, Human Vault, Novakill, and TC75. The EP also includes an alternative version of an older track. What stands out most here is undoubtedly the title track itself, which shows strong potential, alongside several successful remixes — especially Novakill’s contribution, which turns out to be my personal favorite. (Rating:7). Listen to “Call The Dead”: https://aliensproduction.bandcamp.com/track/call-the-dead
items._cn_summary: The Witch Said No 是一支来自俄罗斯的暗黑电子项目，通过斯洛伐克独立厂牌 Aliens Production 发行数字 EP《Call The Dead》。音乐以暗黑电子（Dark-Electro）为核心手法，依赖重型轰炸式鼓点与高度重复的合成器序列推进，辅以几乎无法辨识、充满敌意的人声处理。EP 收录三首新曲、六首混音及一首旧作另类版本。同名主打曲目展现出较强的潜力，两首新曲则稍显说服力不足；混音部分以 Novakill 的版本最为突出。整体风格落在暗黑电子/EBM 的传统范畴内，制作工整但实验性与创新性有限，重复结构较为模式化。俄罗斯项目的身份与东欧独立厂牌的发行渠道为其增添了一定的神秘感与地域色彩，但音乐本身并未呈现明显的跨类型融合或先锋突破。

items.body: When the fields of the cross were burning Our paths would go their separate ways Somehow we were always learning Learning from our own mistakes DETOXi’s In Laughter carries the strange charge of unfinished business: a song born in the pandemic years, finally given its full second life. Southern California deathrock has always known how to turn damage into drama, but this track carries itself with a bruised grandeur that feels earned, shaped by absence, distance, and the weird ache of art left suspended when the world stopped mid-sentence. Musically, the song feels cut from a generous, high-hearted lineage. There is the romantic sweep of The Cult, the broad reach of Midnight Oil, the open-road lift of Big Country, the hard tension of Killing Joke, and a flash of Aztec Camera’s bittersweet clarity in the way melody and feeling are allowed to meet head-on. Jennings sings straight into a memory with a killer anthemic chorus, while the band pushes forward with a handsome urgency, turning grief into motion and ultimately release. Lyrically, In Laughter traces a relationship marked by fear, separation, and unresolved longing, returning again and again to the idea that love survives through joy rather than pain. Burning fields, graves, frozen time, and repeated invitations give the song the feeling of a letter written after the worst has already happened, when tenderness becomes the last brave act left. Director Braedon Roller treats the performance video like a transmission from a band interrupted by history, then summoned back by the force of unfinished feeling. “For this project, I wanted to borrow stylistically from David Lynch’s Blue Velvet,” says Roller. “I’ve always been struck by the candy-colored clown scene and thought that lighting and mood would be perfect inspiration for a music video. I also pulled from films like [Robert Eggers’] The VVitch and…Nosferatu: dark, desaturated imagery living in blue and orange tones. The song has this haunting beauty to it, and I wanted to capture that while really focusing on the emotion of the performance. One technique I like to use is having the singer perform in double time while overcranking the camera, then slowing the footage down in post so the performance lands perfectly on tempo. It creates this strange, hypnotic effect that felt right for this song. The video was filmed across two separate nights, over 4 years, and the edit was incredibly labor-intensive, but I’m really proud of how it turned out.” Watch the video for In Laughter below: The backstory of the band has the cruel timing of a rock-and-roll fable. DETOXi played the vinyl release show for their debut album, First Flesh, on Leap Year Day in 2020, only days before record stores and venues closed, putting the band’s momentum into a deep freeze. During the uncertainty that followed, they kept recording, releasing the In Laughter EP in March 2021 and beginning work on a video for the title track. Then life scattered the pieces: Derek Jennings relocated to Portland, Oscar Estrada and John Crerar started HEAD CUT, and Matt Barks turned his focus toward projects outside music. DETOXi Still, In Laughter kept moving. DJs found it. Fans passed it around. Social media did its strange little underground magic trick, carrying the song into new circles while longtime listeners kept asking when DETOXi might return to the stage. Listen to In Laughter below and order the EP here. In Laughter EP by DETOXI And DETOXi return to the stage Friday, June 26, for their first show since the pandemic, celebrating Crerar’s 50th birthday at Vaquero y Mar in Ventura, California…the same venue where they last played before lockdown. The lineup brings together their earlier incarnation Maask, HEAD CUT, Guilty Strangers, and Dusk At Midnight. For DETOXi, the circle closes with feedback, friendship, and laughter carrying through the wreckage. Get tickets to the show here. Follow DETOXi: Spotify Instagram Facebook The post “Like Flowers on a Lover’s Grave” — SoCal Post-Punk Outfit DETOXi Unearth Lynchian Video for “In Laughter” appeared first on Post-Punk.com.
items._cn_summary: DETOXi是来自南加州的死亡摇滚乐队，作品属于后朋克/暗潮谱系。歌曲"In Laughter"诞生于疫情期间，音乐融合The Cult的浪漫史诗感、Midnight Oil的宏大格局、Killing Joke的硬朗张力与Aztec Camera的苦甜旋律意识。歌词围绕恐惧、分离与未解的渴望展开，燃烧的田野、墓碑与冰冻时光等意象贯穿始终。音乐视频由Braedon Roller执导，借鉴大卫·林奇《蓝丝绒》中糖果色小丑场景的灯光氛围，融合过曝慢速拍摄等技术，营造出冷暖色调交错的超现实质感。整体定位偏向传统死亡摇滚的情感表达与氛围营造，在暗潮类听众接受范围内，但音乐层面缺少实验声响设计或跨类型融合的突破性元素，文章本身更接近推广性新闻稿而非深度乐评。

items.body: This is my house I’m pretty sure Or did I turn the wrong way at the corner store? There are few things more quietly terrifying than realizing a place meant to hold us no longer seems to know us. A home can turn uncanny without changing shape: the same walls, the same rooms, the same door, and yet the air feels wrong. A party can become alien in an instant. A familiar street can suddenly feel like a wrong turn. Sometimes the most frightening estrangement is not from other people, but from our own certainty — that small internal rupture when memory, perception, and instinct stop agreeing with one another. That uneasy threshold is where Berlin-based quartet Agatha is Dead! place their new single “Strangers.” Taken from their forthcoming debut album Concrete, due out on September 11, the track is a study in dissociation, displacement, and the peculiar horror of feeling locked out of a life that should belong to you. “Strangers” opens with a danceable drum beat and a thick, softly carried shadow-laced bass groove, quickly joined by a rubbery, reverbed guitar figure that glints like a melody half-remembered. It almost masquerades as a piano hook: bright, repetitive, and singable, but with enough coldness in its edges to keep the mood unsettled. There is a trace of the icy, Eastern European post-punk guitar language popularized by acts like Molchat Doma, but Agatha is Dead! bend that familiar vocabulary into something more elastic, melodic, and contemporary. The result is a sound stripped down to its essentials without feeling nostalgic for its own sake. When the vocals enter, roughly half a minute in, they arrive controlled and rhythmic, carrying a poetic cadence with a sighing edge. Rather than pushing the song into melodrama, the performance tightens the tension: the melody becomes more insistent, the groove more infectious, and the chorus gradually takes on an anthemic charge. By the time the central cry of “strangers in my house” rises into view, the track has turned paranoia into a hook — something intimate, frightening, and strangely cathartic. Lyrically, “Strangers” follows a narrator trying to re-enter what should be their own space, only to find every sign of belonging destabilized. The house is familiar, or at least it should be. The faces are not. The details have shifted. The mind keeps searching for a rational explanation — a wrong turn, a misplaced key, a simple mistake — but the deeper dread is that something has gone wrong in perception itself. The refrain’s fear of being “locked me out” lands less like a literal complaint than a plea to return to the self. At around the 2:45 mark, the song shifts into a slower, eerier passage, letting the anguish breathe before the rhythm gathers itself again for the final stretch. It is here that the track’s sense of domestic unease becomes something larger: a fear of being made foreign in your own body, your own memory, your own home. And for anyone who has experienced tragedy and turmoil in their life, loss of continuity is one of the most unsettling things one can experience. Listen to “Strangers” below: Formed during the long winter of 2021, Agatha is Dead! began as a collaboration between Lilly and Noah, building songs in isolation before bringing them into the open. Drawing from the stark emotional landscape of Joy Division and the nocturnal melancholy of The Cure, the band’s sound merges restraint with intensity — a tension that has become central to their live presence. Joined by Joey Ramone Hansen on drums and Arthur on bass, the group quickly established itself within Berlin’s live circuit. Since signing to Duchess Box Records in 2025, Agatha is Dead! have built a reputation for performances that feel both intimate and unsettling. Following showcase appearances at SXSW, the band returned to Berlin for a sold-out headline show at Lido, confirming a growing presence beyond the city’s underground. With Concrete on the horizon, they now move into a wider run of German and European dates, including Reeperbahn Festival and their largest headline show to date at SO36 in Berlin on 25 February 2027. With “Strangers,” Agatha is Dead! step further into a world of dislocation and unease, where the familiar no longer offers comfort and what we once knew begins to blur. Agatha is Dead! items._cn_summary: 柏林四人乐队Agatha is Dead!推出的单曲《Strangers》属于典型后朋克风格作品。音乐以可跳舞的鼓机节奏和厚重的贝斯线条为骨架，搭配带回响的吉他旋律，整体呈现出Molchat Doma式东欧后朋克的冷峻质感。歌词围绕对熟悉空间产生陌生感的主题展开，探讨归属感的瓦解与自我认知的错位。歌曲结构层次清晰，副歌具有旋律感染力，将恐惧感转化为hook。不过作品在编曲和音色上未展现出显著的实验性或跨界融合倾向，偏向传统后朋克语汇的当代延伸，对追求前卫和极端声响的听众而言创新力度有限。整体定位为独立厂牌发行的暗潮/后朋克场景中的扎实之作。

items.body: Damage Code Digital Slaves Miseria Records Damage Code is the new project from Carlos Grabstein and Ben Bunzen of 89s✝︎ and Hammershøi respectively, and deals in a very specific style of old school EBM. Forgoing the oft-taken route of Nitzer Ebb and DAF worship, the duo instead deal in a sound that recalls a swathe of body music acts from Europe that emerged in the early 90s (think Escalator and Aircrash Bureau) that took advantage of advancements in digital electronics while maintaining a healthy amount of grit in their design. As such, Digital Slaves is a record that doesn’t break much in the way of new ground, but makes an impact by keeping its tracks impactful and fast moving, usually running a single groove as hard as possible from beginning to end. Grabstein and Bunzen certainly know what they’re doing with that approach and it pays off well in plenty of the record’s nine tracks; “I’m Sick of These Pigs” has a rhythm that just keeps getting heavier as it progresses, the gravitational pull of its bassline and drums warping its sweeping noise, and monotone vocals towards it. Alternately, Notausgang collab “Monotonia” is all about how its gated pads and samples and echoing synthlines create syncopation, the bass tuned down to a low rattle. There’s a real charm to just how rough and ready Damage Code keep matters without repeating themselves too often. There’s a healthy dose of funk in the awkward tripping-over-its-own-feet synthline on “Menschen im Glitch” and the chintzy fm stabs of “Esclavo Digital”, but neither track cannibalizes the other’s appeal through repetition. A lot of it has to do with pretty canny if uncomplicated sound design choices, such as the wonky spring reverb and belt sander saturation of “Lessons in Pain” and the claustrophobic delays of “Berlin”, which sounds like it’s closing in on you if listened to on headphones. Old school body music is almost a genre that lives and dies by how it balances the appeal of its throwback approach without just recreating the same songs over and over again. It’s weird to think of such a straightforward genre having much in the way of subtlety, but on Digital Slaves Damage Code certainly make a case for how much you can squeeze out of it through strength of craft. Buy it. Digital Slave by DAMAGE CODE The post Damage Code, “Digital Slaves” appeared first on I Die: You Die.
items._cn_summary: Damage Code的《Digital Slaves》是一张扎根于九十年代早期欧洲Body Music传统的EBM专辑，由Carlos Grabstein和Ben Bunzen组建。音乐风格延续了Escalator、Aircrash Bureau等老派Body Music的路子，放弃了Nitzer Ebb和DAF式的模仿路径，转而在数字电子音色中保留粗粝的质感。九首曲目以快速、紧凑的律动为核心，单一Groove从头贯穿到底，不做过多变化。制作上运用了门控pad、采样回响、弹簧混响与失真饱和等老派电子手段，声响设计扎实。专辑整体展现出熟练的工艺水准与清晰的类型意识，但并未在既有框架外探索新的方向，属于传统EBM/Body Music范畴内高完成度的回归式作品。

items.body:
Shinichi Atobe fiends will be in their element with Yuji Takenouchi aka Mr. YT’s iridescent techno-house perlers, his first new material in years and the latest in Short Span’s stream of chef’s kiss goodies.

With ‘Universo’ Short Span look beyond contemporary circles to a cult Japanese artist renowned for a string of EPs in the late ‘90s, and Ron Trent co-productions in the mid ’10s, and only scarcely heard since then on his label Element of Souls. The four-tracker effectively picks up where he left the dance years ago, ushering bodies to effortless flight in a mode that reminds of Shiichi Atobe via Shed and Microworld style Detroit elegance in ‘Acuario’, flexing his fruitiest jazz-fusion-house chops on the whirring swang of ‘Escorpio’. He simmers it down to a breezier flow led by puckered, G-funky trills on ‘Tauro’, and smartly defers gratification on ‘Piscis’, blooming lushest harmonic pads that eventually sync with syrupy deep house grooves for graceful end-of-night business.
items._cn_summary: 日本制作人Mr. YT（竹之内裕二）暌违多年后通过独立厂牌Short Span发行的四曲EP，定位为深浩室与底特律电子舞曲领域的回潮之作。整体风格融合爵士融合的灵活律动与底特律电子的优雅质感，编曲中可见果味十足的爵士和声、缥缈的氛围铺垫以及深夜向的浩室律动。制作手法以模拟质感音色与流畅的舞池逻辑为主，在技艺层面表现出扎实的舞曲功底，但更偏向类型内部的精致打磨，实验性元素与前卫探索相对有限。适合偏好电子舞曲与爵士融合交汇地带、同时关注小众日厂与欧美地下舞曲脉络的听众。

items.body:
Someone had to do it: Ennio Morricone and co.’s creepy OST for Pier Paolo Pasolini’s scandalous ’75 film rendition of the notorious novel ‘120 Days of Sodom’, by Marquis De Sade, lands on arch industrialist label, Cold Spring. Mangia!

Next in the label’s line of cult scores, after ‘Decoder’ and Psychic TV’s ‘A Prayer for Derek Jarman’, comes this deeply uneasy score to Pasolini’s infamous enactment of De Sade’s pornographic dystopia-come-study of male power dynamics. Whether you’ve seen it or not, the book and film’s reputation precedes them as both a piece of pure, unadulterated filth, or handy encyclopaedia of depravity, depending on one’s take. Each to their own, as one might say, but fuck me: without going into snuff or dark web realms, the imagery is about as mad as it gets. Which all makes the soundtrack of breezy to discordant chamber classical (Bach, Chopin, Orff, Puccini, and Graziosi) and parlour jazz arrangements register even harder in the memory, especially when paired with its scenes representing everything from coprophilia to bestiality, incest, and worse.
items._cn_summary: 这张专辑是埃尼奥·莫里科内为帕索里尼1975年争议电影《萨罗》所作的配乐，由专注暗黑与工业音乐的独立厂牌Cold Spring发行。配乐以室内古典（巴赫、肖邦、奥尔夫、普契尼、格拉齐奥西等）与沙龙爵士编排为主，从轻快明快到不和谐刺耳均有涉及。与影片所呈现的极端影像内容形成强烈反差，这种美学张力是本作品的核心特征。莫里科内的配乐在传统古典与沙龙爵士的语汇中穿插不和谐元素，与影片的禁忌主题构成诡异的对话。整体定位介于传统古典与暗黑工业美学之间，厂牌背景与极端艺术的结合为作品增添了跨领域的实验色彩。

items.body:
The first new music from Gilla Band in nearly 4 years, 'Giraffe'.

"For over ten years now, the Dublin quartet — vocalist Dara Kiely, guitarist Alan Duggan Borges, bassist Daniel Fox, and drummer Adam Faulkner — have been redefining what you could loosely call “rock music” in the 21st century, influencing a wide swath of similarly forward-thinking guitar acts along the way.

The band perfected a vision that wasn’t quite post-punk, wasn’t quite noise-rock, wasn’t quite anything besides an idiosyncratic, ground-breaking hybrid that could only come from the four of them - Giraffe is their bold new offering."
items._cn_summary: 都柏林四人组 Gilla Band（原名 Girl Band）沉寂近四年后发表新作《Giraffe》。乐队由主唱 Dara Kiely、吉他手 Alan Duggan Borges、贝斯手 Daniel Fox 和鼓手 Adam Faulkner 组成，活跃逾十载。其音乐被描述为一种独特的混合体——既不完全是后朋克，也不完全是噪音摇滚，更像是一种专属于四人组合的突破性风格。他们被视作重新定义二十一世纪摇滚音乐的乐队之一，影响了众多前卫吉他乐团。这张专辑延续了他们大胆的实验路线，继续探索自身独特的声响边界。

items.body:
Budapest based concept label Blue Sun welcomes formerly independent local afrobeat-jazz ensemble to its catalogue with a nuanced 4 tracker EP.

"The release not only marks the beginning of the collaboration, but a definite new musical direction in the band’s life.

Written in a one week jam session retreat in the Hungarian countryside, and recorded at one of the highest peaks of Hungary after a year of global touring, The Garden becomes an amalgamation of the band's personal and artistic experiences. The material conveys a more jazzier approach, with complex harmonies, and an almost cinematic, dreamlike atmosphere, somewhat distancing from (but not completely forgetting) the previously emphasized, dance-oriented Afro- and Latino roots. Song for Ramon serves as the EP’s emotional climax inspired by the passing of a close friend and local underground chef pioneer.

The groove-driven ensemble blends afrobeat, jazz, and various strands of world music into a sound that is both rhythmically powerful and harmonically adventurous. With an eleven-piece lineup featuring an expansive horn section, multiple vocalists, percussion, and keys, the band moves effortlessly between dancefloor energy and more intricate, jazz-influenced musical ideas.

Like the band’s previous album, the EP was again recorded, mixed, and mastered by András Weil, the producer behind The Qualitons, the only hungarian band ever performed Live at KEXP. This continuity preserves Hakumba’s recognizable sonic identity while giving space for new colors and more complex musical ideas to emerge."
items._cn_summary: Hakumba 是一支来自布达佩斯的十一人大编制乐队，风格融合非洲节奏、爵士乐与多元世界音乐元素。专辑《The Garden》在匈牙利乡村经过一周即兴创作后录制于该国一处高海拔地区，乐风较以往更偏向爵士化方向，呈现复杂和声与近乎电影化的梦幻氛围，同时保留了 Afrobeat 和拉丁根源的律动底色。乐队拥有完整的铜管声部、多位歌手、打击乐与键盘配置，在舞曲能量与精致爵士构思之间自如切换。制作人 András Weil 曾与匈牙利知名乐队 The Qualitons 合作，保持了乐队的辨识度。整体而言，这是一张具有东欧独立厂牌气质的世界爵士融合作品，兼具节奏张力与和声探索性，但在实验性与前卫性方面仍偏向传统融合乐范畴。

items.body:
Balmat alum Patricia Wolf flits to Ransom Note’s ambient tape series with a 45 min session of carefully pruned synth wooze and new age whims evoking private press cassettes via early ‘90s garden centres.

"‘Yarrow’ is a bouquet of new music by Portland, Oregon-based musician and field recordist Patricia Wolf, marking the label’s ninth release and the third of Season Two. The works are her reflections on the life cycle of plants and their dynamic ecological relationships.

Wolf created the album in response to her artist residency at the Rocky Mountain Biological Laboratory in Gothic, Colorado, as part of the Art-Science Exchange Project in the summer of 2024. She worked closely with ecologists Dr Paul CaraDonna, Dr Amy Iler, Dr Jane Ogilvie, Dr Nickolas Waser, Dr Mary Price, and Dr Will Petry, spending weeks engaged in long-term research on plants, pollinators, and their interactions as the climate changes. 

Each track on Yarrow looks at a different part of a plant’s life. The songs touch on the conditions that plants need to grow, the quiet life of roots, how flowers attract pollinators, and the strength of seeds. The first single, 'Inflorescence', the scientific name for the floral display that a plant makes in an effort to reproduce, captures this event in song. The music slowly builds layers, reflecting the album’s overall feel. The album ends with the majestic Boards of Canada-esque 'Adapted for Extreme Conditions', and the entire b-side features Patricia’s field recordings from around Gothic, Colorado, and a guided meditation by Dr Paul CaraDonna, whose research inspired the project, inviting listeners to tune into the sounds and activities of the ecosystem."
items._cn_summary: Patricia Wolf是来自美国波特兰的田野录音师与音乐人，这张专辑源自她在科罗拉多落基山生物实验室的驻留项目，与多位生态学家合作完成。作品以田野录音为基底，融合环境合成器音景与新世纪元素，氛围舒缓而冥想化，整体风格让人联想到早期九十年代私人出版磁带和Boards of Canada式的朦胧质感。每首曲目对应植物生命周期的不同阶段，B面收录了来自科罗拉多哥特镇的实地录音及一段生态学家的引导冥想。整体定位为Ransom Note氛围磁带系列第九号发行，概念上将音乐创作与生态科学研究深度结合，属于融合田野录音与氛围电子的跨界作品，但音色语汇相对温和，实验锐度有限。

items.body:
One of the weirdest gadges in UK dub flexes his authority on unique concoctions of roots reggae, digidub, cumbia, and folksy chamber drone for the Breadminster Board of Abstinence. big tipped FFO Nearly God, Tapes Lee “Scratch” Perry & The Congos, Elysia Crampton, DINTE archives.

In cool pursuit of his reggae-voiced folk covers LP for FatCat, ‘Perpetual Musk’ - and 12”s for Accidental Meetings, Elijah Minnelli keeps it ideally offbeat with a deft, hands-on concision and deeply rooted steez throughout ‘Clams As A Main Meal.’ There’s a charmingly daft backstory involving oysters, frisky fictional villagers, and burnt-out hippies, that gives the LP its title, but let’s focus on the music here. 

It’s dead special stuff, surely certified by Dennis Bovell chiming in like all members of The Congos at once in the swaying harmonies knit to nyabinghi drums in ‘Canaan Land' somehow sounding like a score to an Emir Kusturica film, while Welsh singer Carwyn Ellis helps characterise Minnelli’s dare-to-differ audness on the sea-legged cumbia shanty ‘Donna Donna (Chwerthin)’ which clearly suits their lilt of their mother tongue. 

Elsewhere the producer’s feted dub tekkerz and feel for proper folk wise dub groove really come into play, in step from the jaw harp twang and jaw bone friction dematerialised in ‘Sumptuous Promise,’ thru a heavy lamenting ‘Watercraft Apologist’ that wouldn’t sound out of place in a Mark Jenkin flick, to the insectoid digidub of ‘Calopify Now!,’ gently psychoactive cumbia of ‘Bomb the Green Belt,’ and ghostly chamber keen of ‘Long Conifer.’ Play it over and again!
items._cn_summary: 这张专辑是英国制作人Elijah Minnelli在小型独立厂牌旗下发行的实验性dub作品，将根源雷鬼、数字化dub、cumbia和民谣室内嗡鸣声融为一体。制作人邀请了传奇dub制作人Dennis Bovell参与和声编排，以及威尔士语歌手Carwyn Ellis献声。整体风格在传统dub根基上进行大胆拓展，融合了田野录音质地与电子声响处理。配乐氛围被类比为库斯图里卡电影的配乐，具有叙事性和异域色彩。专辑背后还有一个围绕牡蛎、小说化村民和疲惫嬉皮士的怪诞叙事框架。从口琴民谣、原声器乐到电子合成的过渡较为自然，体现了制作人对多种音乐传统的整合能力。

items.body:
Tapes touches bass(bins) with OG patrons Jahtari on a bevy of digi-dancehall party starters.

Big fun, this one! Back in his dub lane after the fruity flex of ‘Funk Plates Vol. 1’ (2023) for Disrupt’s adorable label, Jackson Bailey aka Tapes taps right into the label’s dub and chip tune tastes with a mix of full fat originals and 8-bit versions bound to put a big daft grin on red-eyed mugs. 

Stepping up nimbly strongback with dancehall croaker ‘Photos of my Frog’, riddled with sampled snippets of said snaps, she appears to weave in waviest traces of South African bubblegum top lines in the gummier bubble of ‘Cleat Skank’, replete with a saturated, bit-crushed version on the skweee tip.

Dung below he toes a darker dancehall line laden with killer snares, Gregorian ribbet and mystic melodies in ‘Ramp Up’ and the irresistible UK steppers momentum of a ‘Back Cramp’ licked up with frothiest choral vamps, whistles, and amphibian motifs that come squashed like King Tubby fucking with the OG Prince of Persia OST.
items._cn_summary: Tapes（Jackson Bailey）在德国独立厂牌Jahtari发行EP，融合数字dancehall、8-bit芯片音乐与dub制作手法。专辑包含原创作品及其芯片化重制版本，采样合成蛙鸣、对话片段与合唱人声，节奏受dancehall与UK steppers律动影响。'Cleat Skank'融入南非bubblegum旋律线条，'Ramp Up'展现暗色调dancehall质感。制作涉及bit-crush、采样拼贴等实验声响处理，乐评将其类比为King Tubby对Prince of Persia原声带的再加工。整体定位介于地下club场景与实验电子制作之间，具有一定的跨界融合意识。

items.body:
Burial chases his ace remix of Luke Slater’s ‘Love’ with a redress of the UK techno legend’s L.B. Dub Corps.

Ironically enough, Slater’s very Burial-esque original is reframed as a fairly straight-playing, deep techno tune by the secretive south Londoner himself. Rising up on a beatific organ draught, and rolling out to shuffled hardcore 2-step break overlaid with Slater’s gauzy vox, the original clearly derives from a vein of UK rave spirit that has long perfused Burial’s catalogue.

The remix therefore perhaps falls slightly short of expectations, quite simply reducing the elements to a distant warehouse throb while stretching it out to twice the length, compressing and filtering the vox to an eyrie thizz and reserving the organ refrain to a elegiac coda. Will probably sound ace when munted, though.
items._cn_summary: 本专辑收录了英国电子音乐人Burial对Luke Slater旗下L.B. Dub Corp项目的混音作品。原作以悠扬的风琴旋律为基底，叠加硬核二步碎拍与朦胧人声，承袭了深厚的英伦锐舞传统。Burial的混音版本将元素大幅简化，转化为远距离仓库式的深沉techno律动，将时长拉长至原作的两倍，并对人声进行压缩与滤波处理，风琴段仅在尾声部分出现。整体展现出内敛而幽暗的电子声响美学，但评论认为该混音在表现力上略有不足，未能完全达到听众的期待。

items.body:
I’ve long agreed with the contention that blues music was born in Saharan Africa, and the most recent affirmation is courtesy of “Tansihay” by Hamida Ag Fano, a Malian Tuareg carrying on with the same sort of electrified roots that have emerged abundantly from West Africa in recent times. 

Author: Tom Orr
Tom Orr is a California-based writer whose talent and mental stability are of an equally questionable nature. His hobbies include ignoring trends, striking dramatic poses in front of his ever-tolerant wife and watching helplessly as his kids surpass him in all desirable traits.

[image:Share]
items._cn_summary: 马里图阿雷格音乐人Hamida Ag Fano的专辑《Tansihay》延续了西非撒哈拉地区的电声根音乐传统，将传统图阿雷格音乐语汇与电声乐器结合。乐评将其置于'蓝调起源于撒哈拉以南非洲'这一论题下加以肯定，暗示作品继承了西非图阿雷格沙漠布鲁斯的血脉。整体定位偏向传统世界音乐范畴，保留民族文化色彩，在编曲和声音设计上具有一定的融合性，但评论未提及突出的实验性、前卫性或跨界创新元素。作为来自非洲马里的独立厂牌发行作品，具备地区和文化上的独特价值，但乐评内容极为简短，信息量不足，难以全面评估其艺术深度。

items.body: “Beautiful Patience” takes its name from sabr jamil, the patience Yaqub holds in the Quran when his son Yusuf is taken from him, across years, without complaint. Ghuraba الغرباء, the London duo of Mohammed Salih and Abdullah Mufa, build the track out of that. Salih plays electric guitar across Gnawa, Saharan blues and Anatolian modal territory, Mufa on the Ocean Drum, a frame drum filled with metal beads that roll across the skin. “Beautiful Patience” is one of the brighter tracks on Red Belly Robin, the duo’s second EP, released on 16 May, where Kazakh and Kyrgyz folk and a stray bluegrass lick open the vocabulary out from the heavier ground of 2025’s 6 Days. Both players are Muslim and work from inside the Sufi musical canon, and Salih has described the track as his reading of how the Yusuf story has shaped the way he sees the world. Stream “Beautiful Patience” and listen to Red Belly Robin via THIS LINK The post Daily Discovery: Ghuraba – الغرباء Beautiful Patience appeared first on Rhythm Passport.
items._cn_summary: 伦敦二人组Ghuraba由Mohammed Salih（电吉他）与Abdullah Mufa（海浪鼓）组成，音乐以苏菲音乐传统为根基，横跨Gnawa、撒哈拉布鲁斯、安纳托利亚调式，并融合哈萨克与柯尔克孜民谣元素，甚至点缀蓝草风格。他们的第二张EP《Red Belly Robin》中收录了这首以古兰经雅各布（先知叶尔孤白）故事为灵感的《Beautiful Patience》，将宗教叙事与跨地域音乐语汇结合。海浪鼓的使用为作品增添了独特的音色质感，整体呈现出中东、北非与中亚多元文化交汇的世界融合面貌。作品在传统与跨文化探索方面有一定深度，但在实验性、即兴维度及声响设计的前卫性上较为有限。

items.body: Steve Roach‘s “Quiet Music” series, originally recorded between 1983 and 1986 and released on Projekt Records, will be available on vinyl for the first time as a complete 3LP set. The Steve Roach “Quiet Music” 40th Anniversary edition is pressed on three ultra clear 140g LPs in a limited edition of 300 copies, and will be out August 7, 2026 so Audioglobe informs. The set collects all three original “Quiet Music” albums in one outer sleeve with black paper inner sleeves and a two-sided credits insert. The pressing is 140g ultra clear vinyl, limited strictly to 300 copies. The full tracklist across the three LPs is as follows. “Quiet Music 1”: A1 “The Green Place, Part I” (24:44); B1 “The Green Place, Part II” (24:52). “Quiet Music 2”: A1 “See Things” (5:45); A2 “Towards the Blue” (3:20); A3 “Something in Tears” (5:18); A4 “A Few More Moments” (13:05); B1 “Air and Light” (25:51). “Quiet Music 3”: A1 “Dreaming and Sleep” (18:16); A2 “Quiet Canon” (7:28); B1 “Sleep and Dreaming” (24:47). Quiet Music by Steve Roach Here’s what Steve Roach says on “Quiet Music” at 40 years: “In looking at the arc of my music, 40 years after creating Quiet Music,” Roach stated in the release materials, “I still feel an unbroken connection to this same inner breath and pulse I was discovering within myself and my creative life at that time. Even with everything that was going on in the early ’80s — musically, culturally, politically — this music came to exist in its own dimension, outside of that time, separate from the day-to-day climate in which I was surrounded. I was yearning to express a timeless and universal soul-tone, a safe haven within the music.” Composer Harold Budd said this when the release first came out in 1986: “I think Steve Roach’s Quiet Music is his best album. It’s not that it’s simply pretty (which it is), but there’s an odd edge lurking in the background that moves it miles away from ‘New Age’ torpor. This is a lovely album from a composer working at the top of his skills.” About Steve Roach Steve Roach is an American composer and performer born in 1955, based in Tucson, Arizona. He began working with synthesizers in the early 1980s and established an international reputation through recordings released on Projekt Records, among other labels. His 1984 album “Structures from Silence” – reissued on its third vinyl edition by Projekt in April 2025 – is considered a foundational work of ambient music. The “Quiet Music” series originated in commissions for healing-arts programmes and was released on cassette in 1986; the recordings draw on synthesizers, flute, electric piano and natural sounds. Roach has continued releasing new studio and live work at high frequency; Our most recent coverage concerned the limited 2CD live release “La Rosa — Live in Tucson, 2025” in May 2026. The “Quiet Music” 3LP set, out August 7, 2026, marks the first time the complete series has been issued on vinyl in a single edition.
items._cn_summary: Steve Roach《Quiet Music》系列四十周年纪念黑胶再版的新闻通告。该系列原为1983至1986年间创作的环境音乐作品，融合合成器、长笛、电钢琴与自然声效，发行于独立厂牌Projekt Records。Harold Budd曾评价此作为Roach最佳专辑，兼具美感与内在张力，被视为环境音乐领域的奠基之作。此次再版限量300张，采用超透明黑胶压片工艺，附完整曲目列表与制作人引言。文章本质上为厂牌发行公告而非原创乐评，信息以产品介绍和历史背景为主，缺乏对音乐本体音响设计、创作技法的深入分析。整体音乐风格契合电子/环境音乐偏好，但作为资讯类文本其参考价值有限。

The repress replicates the original 2014 LP programme in full across two sides. Side A: “Venerated & Despised” (2:34), “A Black Egg” (3:54), “Castrate Christ” (4:37), “Liken Ingen Jord Vill Svälja” (2:34), “Alone/A/Cross/Abyss” (3:48). Side B: “Thirty-Nine Lashes” (2:37), “The Seventh Man” (3:24), “Konung Krönt I Blod” (3:30), “A Ceaseless Howling” (3:29), “He Who Is My Mirror” (5:17). Perfection & Permanence by Trepaneringsritualen About Trepaneringsritualen Trepaneringsritualen is a death industrial and ritual ambient project founded by Swedish artist Thomas Martin Ekelund in 2008, initially based in Göteborg, Sweden, and later relocating to Berlin, Germany. The project released its first full-length, “Deathward, to the Womb”, in 2012 on Cold Spring Records. Side-Line reviewed the album at the time of release. “Perfection & Permanence” followed in 2014 on the same label, issued simultaneously on CD and LP; the white vinyl LP edition was limited to 500 copies. In 2017, Trepaneringsritualen released the full-length “Kainskult” on Tesco Organisation, and the project also collaborated with MZ.412 on the live document “Post Industriale / Rituals” 2LP. The same year, the project compiled two earlier split LPs on the CD “Yours Is a Kingdom of Death”. In 2018, Trepaneringsritualen and Nordvargr released “Alpha Ænigma”, a collaborative album. The project subsequently appeared on Cold Spring’s compilation “Arise – A Cold Spring Sampler” in 2023. In 2021, Thomas Martin Ekelund partnered with Henrik Nordvargr Björkk on “Lidaverken Del I: Att i Vådeld Förgås”. The project has released further albums including “ᛉᛦ – Algir; eller Algir i Merkstave” (2019) and “The Totality of Death (A)” and “The Totality of Death (Ω)” (both 2024). The repress of Trepaneringsritualen “Perfection & Permanence” is available via Cold Spring Records.

items.body: Denver project Neo Dimes has released “Alone,” a ten-track debut full-length album spanning darkwave, neo-industrial, alternative rock and synthpop. The album arrived on vinyl and cassette on May 19, 2026, with the digital release scheduled later this month later. Neo Dimes is the solo project of Denver-based musician Stephen Edmunds. “Alone” addresses digital-age isolation, algorithmic control, surveillance capitalism, online extremism and the experience of aging into a world shaped by technology. The record mixes neo-industrial, alternative rock, darkwave and synthpop. Alone by Neo Dimes The album’s artwork is built around a visual narrative: each of the ten single covers functions as a chapter, representing themes of paranoia, persuasion, control and acceptance, which combine to form the final album cover. Edmunds commented as follows on the album’s intent: “I recently lost a career right as my daughter came into the world — a world where she has fewer rights than her mother did and where tyranny is creeping into every facet of life. We’re addicted to the technology in our pockets that opens us to the world by consuming us entirely. It’s omnipresent and inescapable, and I’m pissed off.” Several tracks were released as singles ahead of the album. “Beasts” addresses what Edmunds describes as the radicalization of young men in the wake of the collapse of the American dream. “Angels” casts digital connectivity and surveillance as a modern substitute for guardianship. “Don’t Think” addresses manufactured consent and propaganda. “Trigger” connects personal experiences of addiction, anxiety and isolation. Note that a music video for “Trigger,” directed by Ty Borkowski, was also released. About Neo Dimes Neo Dimes is the solo project of Stephen Edmunds, a Denver, Colorado-based musician. Edmunds has spent most of his life as a musician, starting with guitar in hardcore and metal bands before moving into shoegaze and experimental music. The Neo Dimes project developed over approximately seven years, during which Edmunds worked through the production and compositional process largely through self-teaching. The project made its first public appearance in late 2024, when Edmunds contributed a remix of “Careful What You Wish For” by Highlands. The first original Neo Dimes material appeared in late 2025, with the single “Angels” released on October 30, 2025, followed by “Beasts” on December 9, 2025. Further singles, including “Don’t Think,” preceded the album’s release. Edmunds cites Nine Inch Nails, Depeche Mode and Deftones as primary influences, with The Cure, Joy Division, Brian Jonestown Massacre, My Bloody Valentine and The Prodigy also cited as formative references. “Alone” is the first full-length release under the Neo Dimes name.
items._cn_summary: Neo Dimes 是丹佛音乐人 Stephen Edmunds 的单人项目，处女作《Alone》融合了暗潮、新工业、另类摇滚与合成器流行四种风格。专辑共十首作品，主题聚焦于数字时代的孤立感、算法控制、监控资本主义与网络极端主义，概念上具有较强的社会批判性。制作上由音乐人自学完成，经历了约七年的创作打磨，视觉设计采用十张单曲封面拼合成完整专辑封面的叙事手法。主要影响来源为 Nine Inch Nails、Depeche Mode 与 Deftones，兼有 The Cure、Joy Division、My Bloody Valentine 等后朋克与鞋钉派的痕迹。整体定位介于工业暗潮与合成器流行之间，与纯实验或前卫路线有一定距离，但在黑暗系电子音乐范畴内具备一定深度。

items.body: French duo Potochkine‘s 2025 album “Sang d’Encre” is back in a second limited vinyl pressing on the young & cold label Audioglobe informs us. The new edition is limited to 333 copies on grey splatters vinyl. The first vinyl edition of “Sang d’Encre,” issued in late 2025, was pressed on red transparent with black marble vinyl. The current pressing uses grey splatters vinyl. Both pressings are limited to 333 copies. The album is also available on CD and digital. Sang d'Encre by POTOCHKINE “Sang d’Encre” holds seven tracks: “Bi,” “Endorphines,” “Partir,” “Tristesse Fantasmée,” “Bonnie,” “Pénurie de Larmes,” and the closing ambient piece “La Source.” Two tracks have accompanying videos: “Bi” and “Endorphines”. About Potochkine Potochkine is a French dark electronic duo formed in Paris in 2016, composed of vocalist Pauline Alcaïdé and producer Hugo Sempé. The pair built their sound around French-language vocals, electronic rhythms and a production approach drawing on EBM, electro and elements of darkwave and coldwave. The duo’s debut was the EP “Libérez votre imagination” (2016), which introduced their combination of dark electronics and theatrical staging. They followed with the self-titled album “Potochkine” (2018) and “Mythes” (2019), before releasing “Sortilèges” in 2021 on young & cold – their first release for the German label. A remix companion, “Sortilèges dans le club,” also appeared in 2021. The single “Endorphines” was released in 2024 ahead of “Sang d’Encre.” “Sang d’Encre” was released in autumn 2025 on young & cold as Potochkine’s fourth studio album and their second record for the label. The second vinyl pressing, on grey splatters vinyl, is available now through the young & cold webshop and its distribution network via Audioglobe.
items._cn_summary: Potochkine是来自巴黎的法国暗潮/电子二人组，由主唱Pauline Alcaïdé和制作人Hugo Sempé于2016年组建，作品以法语演唱为特色，融合EBM、electro、darkwave与coldwave等暗电子元素。2025年专辑《Sang d'Encre》收录七首曲目，涵盖俱乐部向的电子节拍与氛围化的收尾曲，由德国独立厂牌young & cold发行，现推出灰色飞溅彩色乙烯基限量第二版，限量333张。该组合自2016年EP处女作以来已发布四张录音室专辑，音乐定位在暗潮与工业电子交叉地带，兼具剧场化的舞台表现力。本文为vinyl再版的新闻通告，缺乏对音乐本身的深度评论与艺术分析。
